result.title: VLCQ: Post-training quantization for deep neural networks using variable length coding
result.comment: Published in Future Generation Computer Systems, Volume 166 (2025), Article 107654
result.summary: Quantization plays a crucial role in efficiently deploying deep learning models on resource-constrained devices. Post-training quantization does not require access to the original dataset or retraining the full model. Current methods that achieve high performance close to baseline results typically require INT8 fixed-point integers. However, achieving higher model compression with lower bit-widths often leads to significant performance degradation. In this paper, we propose VLCQ, a post-training quantization method that relaxes the fixed-point encoding constraint, enabling more flexible exploration of quantization techniques through variable-length encoding. This approach achieves competitive or improved performance while reducing bit-widths, without requiring access to training data or model fine-tuning. Extensive experiments on image classification, segmentation, and object detection demonstrate that VLCQ improves model compression and accuracy compared with state-of-the-art post-training quantization approaches. For per-channel quantization, VLCQ surpasses FP32 accuracy and Piece-Wise Linear Quantization (PWLQ) on most evaluated models, achieving up to 6x compression compared with FP32 and up to 1.7x compared with PWLQ. When prioritizing compression with limited accuracy loss, VLCQ achieves up to 12.25x compression compared with FP32 with less than 4% performance degradation. For per-tensor quantization, VLCQ is competitive with Data-Free Quantization (DFQ), while providing greater flexibility to achieve lower bit rates across different tasks and models.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 VLCQ，一种无需训练数据与微调的后训练量化方法，用变长编码替代定点整数编码，以在更低比特下保持分类、分割、检测任务的精度与压缩率。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作关注权重/激活的压缩编码与部署效率，未涉及视觉推理状态、证据获取或计算分配机制，仅「变长」一词与自适应推理步数形似，缺乏可核查的具体借鉴线索，故排除。
